descricao_fonte: KUB Radiograph showing a large staghorn calculus involving the major calyces and renal pelvis in a person with severe scoliosis. Struvite stones can grow rapidly, forming large calyceal staghorn calculi which can require invasive surgery such as percutaneous nephrolithotomy or even anatrophic nephrolithotomy for definitive treatment.
